employment_hours_earnings: Holds time-series observations of employment/hours/earnings by series (one row per series_id × period): keys series_id, year, period, date; measures value and footnote_codes; metadata series_title.
employment_hours_earnings_series: Holds series-level metadata for employment/hours/earnings series (one row per series_id): key series_id; attributes supersector_code, industry_code, data_type_code, seasonal, series_title, footnote_codes; coverage begin_year/period and end_year/period.
wm: Holds time-series observations for 'wm' series (one row per series_id × period): keys series_id, year, period, date; measure value and footnote_codes; metadata series_title.
unemployment_cps: Holds time-series observations from CPS unemployment series (one row per series_id × period): keys series_id, year, period, date; measure value and footnote_codes; metadata series_title.
cpi_u: Holds CPI-U time-series observations (one row per series_id × period): keys series_id, year, period, date; measure value and footnote_codes; classification/slices survey_abbreviation, seasonal_code, periodicity_code, area_code, area_name, item_code, item_name, plus series metadata.
c_cpi_u: Holds chained CPI-U time-series observations (one row per series_id × period): keys series_id, year, period, date; measure value and footnote_codes; classification fields survey_abbreviation, seasonal_code, periodicity_code, area_code, area_name, item_code, item_name, plus series metadata.
unemployment_cps_series: Holds CPS unemployment series-level metadata (one row per series_id): key series_id; many categorical attributes (lfst_code, periodicity_code, series_title, absn_code, activity_code, ages_code, class_code, duration_code, education_code, entr_code, expr_code, hheader_code, hour_code, indy_code, jdes_code, look_code, mari_code, mjhs_code, occupation_code, orig_code, pcts_code, race_code, rjnw_code, rnlf_code, rwns_code, seek_code, sexs_code, tdat_code, vets_code, wkst_code, born_code, chld_code, disa_code), seasonal, footnote_codes, and coverage begin/end year and period.
wm_series: Holds series-level metadata for wm series (one row per series_id): key series_id; attributes seasonal, area_code, ownership_code, estimate_code, industry_code, occupation_code, subcell_code, datatype_code, level_code, series_title, footnote_codes; coverage begin_year/period and end_year/period.
cpsaat<N>: Holds cross-sectional employment composition by industry (one row per year × detailed industry row): keys year, sector, subsector, industry_group, industry; measures total_employed_in_thousands, percent_women, percent_white, percent_black_or_african_american, percent_asian, percent_hispanic_or_latino.
2007_q<N>: Holds quarterly county/area industry metrics for 2007 (one row per geoid/area_fips): keys geoid, area_fips; repeating industry-specific measures such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_... (location quotients) and similar sets for multiple NAICS group columns like 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23, etc.
2001_q<N>: Holds quarterly county/area industry metrics for 2001 (one row per geoid/area_fips): keys geoid, area_fips; repeating industry-specific measures mirroring 2007_q<N> such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_..., avg_wkly_wage_11_..., month3_emplvl_11_..., lq_... and the same sets for NAICS groups 1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23, etc.
2002_q<N>: Holds quarterly county/area industry metrics for 2002 (one row per geoid/area_fips): keys geoid, area_fips; repeating industry-specific measures mirroring 2007_q<N> and 2001_q<N> such as qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_..., avg_wkly_wage_11_..., month3_emplvl_11_..., lq_... and similar sets for NAICS groups (1024, 61, 53, 1023, 31_33, 23, etc).
2009_q<N>: Contains labor/establishment metrics by area (geoid, area_fips) at the quarter level (one row per geography-quarter) with sector-specific measures: qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients for those measures, plus analogous qtrly_estabs_1024_professional_and_business_services / avg_wkly_wage_1024_professional_and_business_services / month3_emplvl_1024_professional_and_business_services and their lq_ variants, and similar sets for 61_educational_services, 53_real_estate_and_rental_and_leasing, 1023_financial_activities, 31_33_manufacturing, and 23_construction (e.g., qtrly_estabs_31_33_manufacturing, avg_wkly_wage_31_33_manufacturing).
1996_q<N>: Contains labor/establishment metrics by area (geoid, area_fips) at the quarter level (one row per geography-quarter) with sector-specific measures: qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients, and analogous qtrly_estabs/avg_wkly_wage/month3_emplvl and lq_ fields for 1024_professional_and_business_services, 61_educational_services, 53_real_estate_and_rental_and_leasing, 1023_financial_activities, 31_33_manufacturing, and 23_construction.
2019_q<N>: Contains labor/establishment metrics by area (geoid, area_fips) at the quarter level (one row per geography-quarter) with sector-specific measures: qtrly_estabs_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, avg_wkly_wage_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, month3_emplvl_11_agriculture_forestry_fishing_and_hunting, lq_* location quotients, and analogous qtrly_estabs/avg_wkly_wage/month3_emplvl and lq_ fields for 1024_professional_and_business_services, 61_educational_services, 53_real_estate_and_rental_and_leasing, 1023_financial_activities, 31_33_manufacturing, and 23_construction.
dar_non_intersectional_hiring: One row per workforce/report_year with non-intersectional hiring counts or rates by demographic: workforce, report_year, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men.
dar_non_intersectional_attrition_index: One row per workforce/report_year with non-intersectional attrition index values by demographic: workforce, report_year, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men.
dar_intersectional_exits_representation: One row per workforce/report_year with intersectional exit representation by gender and race: workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white.
full_csv-latest-data-is-<N>: One row per industry observation/year with employment and demographic composition: year, sector, subsector, industry_group, industry, total_employed_in_thousands, percent_women, percent_white, percent_black_or_african_american, percent_asian, percent_hispanic_or_latino.
dar_non_intersectional_representation: One row per workforce/report_year with non-intersectional workforce representation by demographic: workforce, report_year, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men.
dar_intersectional_representation: One row per workforce/report_year with intersectional representation by gender and race: workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white.
dar_region_non_intersectional_exits_repr: One row per workforce/report_year/region with non-intersectional exit representation by gender: workforce, report_year, region, gender_women, gender_men.
dar_non_intersectional_exits_representat: One row per workforce/report_year with non-intersectional exit representation by demographic: workforce, report_year, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white, gender_us_women, gender_us_men, gender_global_women, gender_global_men.
dar_intersectional_attrition_index: One row per workforce/report_year with intersectional attrition index values by gender and race: workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white.
dar_region_non_intersectional_hiring: Holds regional hiring counts by workforce and year — grain: one row per (workforce, report_year, region); notable measures/keys: workforce, report_year, region, gender_women, gender_men.
dar_region_non_intersectional_representa: Holds regional representation breakdowns by workforce and year — grain: one row per (workforce, report_year, region); notable measures/keys: workforce, report_year, region, race_asian, race_black_african, race_hispanic_latino_latinx, race_indigenous, race_mena, race_white_european, gender_women, gender_men.
dar_selfid_representation: Holds overall self-identified representation by workforce and year at a global level — grain: one row per (workforce, report_year, global); notable measures/keys: workforce, report_year, global.
dar_region_non_intersectional_attrition_: Holds regional attrition index values by workforce and year — grain: one row per (workforce, report_year, region); notable measures/keys: workforce, report_year, region, gender_women, gender_men.
dar_intersectional_hiring: Holds hiring counts broken down by gender_us and race for a workforce and year — grain: one row per (workforce, report_year); notable measures/keys: workforce, report_year, gender_us, race_asian, race_black, race_hispanic_latinx, race_native_american, race_white.
